item.title: Light Installation Commissions for Clubs & Festivals
item.description: Bespoke LED light installations, laser cut sculptures and stage design for clubs, festivals and events. Designed and built in Bristol, UK, made to tour worldwide. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.

item.title: Sacred Geometry Flower Garden LED Light Installation
item.description: Visitors walking among the illuminated flowers at night. The Sacred Geometry Flower Garden: a walk-through LED light installation of laser cut mandala flowers, shown at Boom Festival and available to hire. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.

item.title: Temple Architectural Design
item.description: Aerial view of the temple and its seven outer sections. A commissioned temple design, modelled in Maya and explored as a walkable real-time VR simulation in Unreal Engine. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.

item.title: Projection Mapped Face Sculpture for Festival Stages
item.description: An early design concept sketch with the 3D face already included. The build process of two video projection mapped face sculptures, designed, built, animated and mapped for music festival visual shows. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.
